summary.method: Live catalog verification: product sitemap (featured image per product) + WooCommerce Store API (slug/name) + direct product-page fetches for validation. Persian normalization per csvSource.normalizePersian (NFKC, ي->ی, ك->ک, Persian digits, ZWNJ, lowercase). No guessed or placeholder images.
notes: 303/347 products (87.3%) show their real product image; 44 fall back to the ProductCard 'image unavailable' placeholder.
43 products were discontinued by the source site (their /product/<id>/ pages return 404 and the ids are absent from the live catalog).
1 live product (2440010) excluded: its only image on the source site is an unrelated lifestyle/stock photo.
All 13 duplicate image URLs are provably shared images on the source site (size/variant families), not mis-mappings.
24 product ids were re-coded by the source site; images assigned only where the normalized product name matches exactly (priority 4 of the spec).
